emily-ops: FYI a visiting ceramicist is dropping off a large teapot for a mini-demo at 3pm. They'll check in at the lobby and need guest badges. Fragile item. :tea:
frontdesk-bot: Delivery recorded 14:48 by ClayShip (AWB CL-4422). Label: 'TEAPOT - FRAGILE'. ETA ~15:05.
frontdesk: Badge printer jammed earlier; might need manual badges. :grimacing:
matthew: Printer error showed PAPER_JAM 0x43. Quick fix: open tray, reseat rollers, hold FEED for 5s. Worked before.
anya: We have 'Temp Badges' kit in reception top drawer (green bin) with stickers & hole punch.
jess: Need a small table + felt pad for the teapot. Can someone move the round cafe table?
sam: I can move the table and bring a dolly. Front couch or high-top?
emily-ops: Front couch so people can sit. Please tag parcel 'ART - DO NOT STACK' and put in cabinet B until artist arrives.
frontdesk: Parcel secured in cabinet B. If printer dies I'll hand out stamped paper slips 1;retro mode engaged.
emyth-ops: Thanks everyone 1; see you at 14:55 to set up.
